payload.summary: MAR-2793 shares one Node ESM API/CLI graph and publishes a standalone public declaration facade.
decisions: The root API remains synchronous and statically imported; the private async CLI validates its own arguments before importing the selected existing implementation module, with imports awaited inside the existing sanitised error boundary.

Bun 1.3.1 transpiles TypeScript and Rollup assembles shared ESM chunks without minification. Cache and records share a chunk because their existing mutual dependency must not form an inter-chunk cycle. All chunks remain directly in dist, preserving executing-package discovery.

TypeScript 7 remains the typecheck and declaration authority. Rollup's declaration plugin bundles the temporary emitted declarations using its documented development-only TypeScript 6 API compatibility package; only dist/index.d.ts is published.

Package checks follow actual static and literal dynamic imports from the two supported entries; all referenced files must be contained and present, Node built-ins are the only externals, and stray outputs/private declarations are rejected. The existing exact tarball byte/mode and metadata checks remain authoritative.
Maintainer performance documents remain in Git and are excluded from npm. Build inventories identify source contributions without introducing another persistent manifest authority.
verification: Fresh-process CLI loader guards reject filesystem, SQLite, crypto and child-process loading for help/version and invalid options.
Packed API, every CLI command, complete public type consumer, import containment and deterministic clean build gates remain required.
